family_predicates.union_prefill: prefill not selected by the M64 override or long-context reverse route; BF16 GQA8/GQA16 and paged causal GQA16 use dedicated source retraces
family_predicates.m64_prefill_override: FLASHINFER_MSA_PREFILL_SCHEDULE=m64, flat BF16 GQA16, eager execution, and maximum KV length at most 8192
family_predicates.long_bf16_reverse_prefill: batch 1 BF16 causal TopK16 prefill, total_q at least 8192, default query offset, and either flat GQA16 KV length at least 8192, paged GQA8 max_pages at least 64, or paged GQA16 max_pages greater than 64
family_predicates.direct_m16_decode: decode not selected by a direct FP8 Q1 or uniform-FP8 override; one selected-block persistent M16 kernel handles Q1 and multi-token decode
family_predicates.fp8_kv_q1_exact_override: BF16-query FP8-KV causal Q1 exact serving shapes selected by the explicit exact schedule
family_predicates.fp8_kv_q1_xform2: BF16-query FP8-KV causal Q1 serving shapes selected by the explicit xform2 schedule
family_predicates.uniform_fp8_qkv_decode: paged causal uniform FP8 Q/K/V, Q1 through Q32, force_fused=True, and default query offset
